text.p: Finnish shipping group Finnlines said on Wednesday it expected full-year earnings to remain below the level in 1996, which included a FIM 115 profit from the sale of forwarder Huolintakeskus.
Its previous forecast was for 1997 operating earnings on par with 1996. The gain on Huolintakeskus was booked among operating items.

"Finnlines' full-year result is expected to remain below the previous year's level, which included a profit of FIM 115 million on the Huolintakeskus sale," it said in a statement with its January-April result.
Finnlines reported January-April pretax earnings down at 132 million markka, from 217 million markka in the year-ago period and operating profit fell to 126 million markka from 224 million,
In 1996, Finnlines posted a 404 million markka profit before extraordinary items and a 444 million markka operating profit.
